Maya (Finance): FYI ScaleGrid's invoice for 2024-03-01 (inv_9172) looks wrong — support line shows $12,345 and compute is $0. GL codes are showing Support:5000 instead of Compute:4000. Stripe says payment succeeded but the PDF line for compute is blank. I filed FIN-3847.
Omar (Eng): ugh. Did anything change in the SKU mapping or the invoice template?
Lina (Billing): we rolled a small SKU schema migration yesterday evening (r2321). It changed the canonical sku -> product_code mapping. I thought the billing job used the old fallback mapping though.
Sam (SRE): can you paste the raw invoice_lines for inv_9172? want to see if descriptions got swapped or if amounts moved between lines.
Maya (Finance): pasted below from the API export: 
```json
[ {"line_id":"l_1001","sku":"rdw.compute.large","desc":"Support - Premium","amount_cents":1234500,"gl_code":"5000"}, {"line_id":"l_1002","sku":"rdw.support.premium","desc":"Compute — GPU hours","amount_cents":0,"gl_code":"4000"} ]
```
Omar (Eng): wow, sku strings look swapped. rdw.compute.large mapped to Support desc. That smells like the sku->desc lookup table got keys/values flipped in the migration.
Lina (Billing): Confirmed in DB: the product_metadata table has product_code in the description column for a subset of rows. Seems like a migration COPY used wrong column order. Filed internal patch PR 657.
Billing Bot: Ticket FIN-3847 updated: label=investigating, assignee=Omar (Eng).
StripeWebhook: payment_intent.succeeded for pi_3J9x — linked to inv_9172 (amount 12345.00).
Omar (Eng): Quick mitigation: I'll add a runtime guard to billing job to fallback to product family by regex when desc/gl mismatch detected. Can do hotfix in next hour.
Maya (Finance): Need to reissue corrected invoice PDF and create credit memo for the incorrect Support charge if hotfix confirms swap. Can we avoid customer-facing churn?
Lina (Billing): If we can generate corrected invoice and mark the old one void, that's standard. I'll prepare email template for accounts and cc ops. Need approval to issue credit memos > $10k.
Maya (Finance): Approve. Reissue + credit memo is fine.
Sam (SRE): I added an alert for future invoice key mismatches and a quick reconciliation job to run nightly for the last 24 hours.
Omar (Eng): Hotfix deployed to billing-worker-prod (r2321-hotfix). Re-ran invoice renderer for inv_9172: now lines are: 
```json
[ {"line_id":"l_1001","sku":"rdw.compute.large","desc":"Compute — GPU hours","amount_cents":1234500,"gl_code":"4000"}, {"line_id":"l_1002","sku":"rdw.support.premium","desc":"Support - Premium","amount_cents":0,"gl_code":"5000"} ]
```
Lina (Billing): I'll void the original PDF, create credit memo CM-673, and issue new invoice INV-9172-v2. Email draft ready.
Maya (Finance): Thanks. Please run a quick runbook: list all invoices in last 48h with sku patterns rdw.compute.* AND desc contains "Support". Post results here when done.
Lina (Billing): running query now, will post results in FIN-3847.
Omar (Eng): Also adding a migration rollback step to the next release and a data fix job to correct misordered rows.
Maya (Finance): Great — keep me posted. :thumbsup:
